research.label: Intelligent autonomy
research.title: Learning to navigate complex, high-stakes environments
research.summary: Developing data-informed approaches to forecasting, routing, and sequential decision-making for autonomous vehicles and connected public-safety systems.
research.question: How can autonomous systems make useful decisions under uncertainty while remaining responsive to human direction?
research.contribution: Risk-aware patrol planning, urban mobility modeling, and adaptive routing informed by changing operational conditions.

research.label: Emergency-response systems
research.title: Making every second of emergency response count
research.summary: Studying the role of unmanned aerial systems, connected sensing, and decision support in triage, search and rescue, and firefighter operations.
research.question: Where can autonomous assistance improve response workflows without obscuring accountability or operator control?
research.contribution: Medical-drone dispatch models and research frameworks for aerial situational awareness and emergency coordination.

research.label: Voice-first computing
research.title: Technology that works when hands and eyes are occupied
research.summary: Exploring hands-free, voice-enabled interfaces, connected devices, and resilient communication tools designed around the realities of field operations.
research.question: How can responders interact with critical information naturally, quickly, and reliably while working under pressure?
research.contribution: Voice-enabled first-responder concepts, drone interaction research, and connected IoT architectures.

research.label: Accountable AI
research.title: Building intelligence that can be examined and trusted
research.summary: Integrating uncertainty, privacy, software assurance, transparency, and human authority into AI-enabled systems that may affect public safety.
research.question: What should a system be permitted to recommend, and how can its decisions be challenged and audited?
research.contribution: Sociotechnical frameworks for accountable police vehicles, governed UAV robotics, and decision-support systems.

research.label: Smart cities & mobility
research.title: Connecting mobility, urban data, and human needs
research.summary: Examining how intelligent transportation systems and cyber-physical infrastructure can strengthen urban resilience and equitable access to services.
research.question: How do sensing, communication, and decision models translate into safer and more inclusive urban operations?
research.contribution: Studies of traffic coordination, autonomous first-response vehicles, location resilience, and smart-city intelligence.

media.title: Zero Trust Framework Proposed to Secure Autonomous Police and Rescue Drones
media.summary: Coverage of research by Swarnamouli Majumdar and Anjali Awasthi proposing a six-layer Zero Trust governance framework for public-safety UAVs, including safeguards for AI reasoning, tool use, human authorization, and audit records.

media.title: SkySentience Framework Aims to Keep Police Drones Accountable Before Incidents Escalate
media.summary: A feature on the SkySentience conceptual framework, highlighting transparent, human-supervised UAV decision support, community oversight, and a proposed evaluation pathway—not a field-tested deployment.

media.title: Artificial Intelligence for Safer Cities and Communities
media.summary: The official March 26 program lists Swarnamouli Majumdar for the keynote “Artificial Intelligence for Safer Cities and Communities” and the industry panel “Redefining Human Intelligence: AI, Emotional, and Cognitive Diversity.” Photographs from the event are featured in the speaking gallery.

media.title: Automating Tasks for First Responders with Zenext AI — Episode 248
media.summary: An interview with Swarnamouli Majumdar on voice-based AI assistance for first responders, hands-free information access, incident documentation, and the evolution of Zenext AI.

media.title: Zenext AI: Swarnamouli Majumdar Explains Hands-Free Communications for Responders
media.summary: Editor Donny Jackson interviews Swarnamouli at the 2024 5×5 Public Safety Innovation Summit about voice-enabled technology intended to help responders communicate without operating a device by hand.

media.title: Swarnamouli Majumdar — Founder & CEO, Zenext AI
media.summary: Startup Canada's community profile introduces Swarnamouli's leadership in voice AI for emergency response and her work connecting technical research, entrepreneurship, and public impact.

media.title: From Automotives to Investments: An Applied Data Science Alumna's Career Journey
media.summary: An Indiana University alumni profile tracing Swarnamouli's path through engineering analytics, autonomous-vehicle technology, and financial data science.

media.title: Team Zenext — Tech to Protect Challenge
media.summary: A NIST Public Safety Communications Research spotlight on Team Zenext, naming Swarnamouli Majumdar as the team speaker and recognizing the team among the competition's top contestants.

media.title: IUPUI Team Awarded $112,500 to Advance Voice AI for Law Enforcement
media.summary: Indiana University reports NIST Tech to Protect Challenge support for the Zenext team and Swarnamouli's role as program manager and technical lead in data science and artificial intelligence.

media.title: Students Win Tech to Protect Challenge, Innovate Informatics Solutions for First Responders
media.summary: Indiana University's early coverage of the team's Tech to Protect Challenge results, including ZENEXT, ALIKE cloud fire safety, and Secure Matrix concepts.

media.title: Are Virtual Assistants about to Take-Off in Global Law Enforcement?
media.summary: An industry feature on virtual assistants in policing highlighted Zenext as an example of voice-command support for law-enforcement workflows and included commentary on human-centered design from Majumdar Swarnamouli.

media.title: AI for Good, public safety, and autonomous systems
media.summary: A public post sharing work at the intersection of AI for good, public safety, and autonomous systems, reflecting the broader mission behind the research and demonstration portfolio featured on this site.
